origins.section: One Schema Validates the Whole Snapshot and Reports Every Problem in One Pass
At a Machine Boundary, Forbid Unknown Keys and Turn Off Guessing
The Schema Is a Versioned Contract, Published as JSON Schema

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-layers: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-layers: "Four, not five. The unknown parent P099 is a rule across records, written as a model validator on `Snapshot` (below), and an after-validator runs only on a model whose fields all passed. So the problems come in two layers: field problems first, and reference problems once the fields are clean." The printed output also shows "P016's unknown parent reported: False".
recorded.prompt:q-defaults: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-defaults: "With "ignore" the document is accepted. `lag` is dropped as unknown, `parent_lag` is missing, and its default fills the gap: P023's lag becomes 0." The page also says "`extra="forbid"` refuses a key the model does not declare (the default, `"ignore"`, drops it)."
recorded.prompt:q-versions: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-versions: "An old document is not ignored or guessed at. It is brought up to date by an explicit step, one per version, before validation." Also: "The upgrade is code with a test, written once, and the schema stays strict."

recorded.prompt:q-layers: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.outcome:q-layers: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'b'

recorded.prompt:q-layers:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-layers:a: Pydantic does collect every field error, but the output "P016's unknown parent reported: False" and "Four, not five" show that the reference problem is not in the first report.
recorded.prompt:q-layers:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-layers:c: "field problems first, and reference problems once the fields are clean". Rules across records run after the field rules, not before.
recorded.prompt:q-layers:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-layers:d: "Pydantic does not stop at the first bad field: it validates every field of every record and returns all the failures in one `ValidationError`". The cost error is reported.
recorded.prompt:q-defaults:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-defaults:a: "With "ignore" the document is accepted". The missing parent_lag has a default, so nothing required is missing.
recorded.prompt:q-defaults:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-defaults:b: Only extra="forbid" refuses undeclared keys. Under the default "ignore" the page says "the document is accepted".
recorded.prompt:q-defaults:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-defaults:c: "`lag` is dropped as unknown", and "the default, `"ignore"`, drops it". Keeping extra keys is `"allow"`, as the Reference table says.
recorded.prompt:q-versions:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-versions:b: "An old document is not ignored or guessed at." The extra="ignore" run drops the renamed column and sets P023's parent_lag to 0. The upgrade "keeps P023's lag of 1".
recorded.prompt:q-versions:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-versions:c: Lax mode only converts values: "a string that clearly means a number is converted". Nothing on the page says it renames keys, and "An old document is not ignored or guessed at. It is brought up to date by an explicit step".
recorded.prompt:q-versions:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-versions:d: "old exports must not be read as if they were new ones. That is what `schema_version: Literal[1]` is for". Documents of another version are refused.
